liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Terrapin Station (First One!)** (1 review): Garcia explores more in the first solo, with guitars having a sharper edge than later versions [18]
- **Playin' In The Band** (1 review): The rare Playin' In The Band, Wheel, and Playin' In The Band sequence closes Set 1 [14]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): Listener identifies the Help On The Way, Slipknot, and Franklin's Tower jam as their favorite part [17]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): Delightful teases of China Cat appear within the Franklin's Tower section to calm tension [19]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Listener highlights a beautiful Keith solo during the Eyes of the World performance [15]
- Listener notes Jerry performs a great solo during The Deal in the first set [16]

## The recordings

- **gd77-02-26.sbd.owen.23808.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 22 songs; 195 min; rated 4.95/5 by 40 [1]. Said about its sound: Listener states this matrix sounds much better than the other circulating soundboard recording; Listener finds this soundboard much better than old tapes with poor sound quality [20][22]
- **gd1977-02-26.sbd.wizard.32009.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 22 songs; 195 min; rated 4.2/5 by 5 [3]
- **gd1977-02-26.sbd.cantor.deibert.83283.flac16**: soundboard; 22 songs; 170 min; rated 4.73/5 by 22 [4]. Said about its sound: Sound Forge 5.0 peak normalization applied to 98 percent, preserving tuning and stage chatter [4]
- **gd1977-02-26.sbd.steve.253.shnf**: soundboard; 23 songs; 170 min; rated 4/5 by 12 [6]. Said about its sound: BettyBoard recording sounds incredible despite a few dropouts and reel changes typical of older shows [6]

## Around the show

- Rick Griffin's mural of a bony clutching the Eternal Scroll was hoisted behind the stage [23]
- The first liquid bottles appeared on the scene during this specific performance [23]
- Dropouts noted at one minute fifty-four seconds in Samson and Delilah [6]
- Listener ranks this performance among their top five shows from the year 1977 [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd77-02-26.sbd.owen.23808.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Main source lineage is SBD to MR to DATs, with AUD patches from Sony ECM-280 [1]
- **gd1977-02-26.sbd.wizard.32009.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Owen Brothers; source: SBD>MR>DAT>CD [3]. Also: Older soundboard source has better dynamics than the newer highly compressed circulating version; Tunings were restored from a SBD to MR to C to C to CD source [3]
- **gd1977-02-26.sbd.cantor.deibert.83283.flac16**: taped by Betty Cantor; transferred by Jace and Tim Diebert; source: Betty Soundboard [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by SONGLYRICS.com: [Grateful Dead – 1977‐02‐26: Swing Auditorium, San Bernardino, CA, USA](https://www.songlyrics.com/grateful-dead/19770226-swing-auditorium-san-bernardino-ca-usa/) [25]
- Fan art by The Music Never Stopped: [Grateful Dead Live at Swing Auditorium on 02/26/1977](https://dayofthedeadshow.home.blog/2019/02/26/grateful-dead-live-at-swing-auditorium-on-02-26-1977/) [26]
- Fan art by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - Dave's Picks Vol 29: 1977-02-26 Swing Auditorium, San Bernardino, CA](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2019/02/grateful-dead-daves-picks-vol-29-1977.html) [27]
- Poster by Amy Harris: [Bob Weir dies at 78; Grateful Dead played San Bernardino twice](https://www.sbsun.com/2026/01/13/bob-weir-dies-at-78-grateful-dead-played-san-bernardino-twice/) [28]
- Poster by Jerrybase: [Grateful Dead – 1977-02-26](https://jerrybase.com/events/19770226-01) [29]
- Fan art by thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com: [Grateful Dead - 1977-02-26 Swing Auditorium, San Bernardino, CA {Betty Board}](https://thecurtainwithblog.blogspot.com/2018/05/grateful-dead-1977-02-26-swing.html) [30]
